own_solution.law: Bernoulli with continuity in a uniform bore: pc = p0 - rho g H - rho g h
assumptions: steady, inviscid, incompressible flow, tube full
large reservoir; surface and outlet at atmospheric pressure

T7E69.regime: irrelevant while pc = 78.76 kPa > vapour pressure

TED68.regime: irrelevant while pc = 78.76 kPa > vapour pressure

defect_reasons.other: T5FCB/T15A1 name only the liquid in the siphon; the R answer relies on the scene clause that the reservoir holds the same liquid as the siphon, which covers it but makes the wording slightly indirect.

notes: Verified: rho=760 -> 101300 - 760*9.8*2.3 = 84169.6 Pa; 1180 -> 74702.8 Pa; 1340 -> 71096.4 Pa; base 78760 Pa. All match. Bore cancels for uniform bore (C). K regime pc > p_vap holds for 3.2, 12, 31 kPa against 78.76 kPa; counter-regime at 110 kPa is correct. Minimal pairs T3DC9/T15A1 and T45C6/T5FCB share 1180 kg/m^3 and differ only in attachment. Disagreement with pass 1: on reflection the scene clause 'the reservoir holds the same liquid as the siphon, and the density given is that of the liquid first put in them' adequately signals that a replacement applies to the circulating liquid, so I downgrade my pass-1 medium wording concern to low.
